pictures.deviceText: Made here, privately and for free, even offline.

pictures.flux2-klein.text: Finer pictures in any shape, in about a minute, by Black Forest Labs’ FLUX.2 [klein], under the Apache 2.0 license. It needs a recent computer with 16 GB of memory.
pictures.z-image-turbo.text: The finest pictures in any shape, words in them spelled right, in about half a minute, by Alibaba’s Z-Image-Turbo, under the Apache 2.0 license. It needs a recent computer with 16 GB of memory.
pictures.filmsText: Films are made without asking first.
